name: Nonomiya Momoko
source:
A resident of the mansion where Kenta lives. As a housekeeper, she takes care of all the housework in the mansion. She has known Aoi, the owner of the mansion, since she was a little girl. 

Although she is a highly skilled housekeeper, she often makes careless mistakes due to her laid-back personality. Even when she makes such mistakes, she does not get depressed, but simply laughs it off.

She has a “nice person who helps me in various ways” level of affection for Kenta, who arrived out of the blue. As they continue their relationship, Kenta and Momoko grow closer.

One day, Momoko asks Kenta out, however, on the day of the date he is tempted by Miko. What choice will Kenta make?

[From [Url=http://13cm.jp/game/bubu/index.html]official site[/url]]
